headline: Nevish Line Flares as Bloodshed Mounts Across Northern Fronts
war_summary: Fresh clashes have erupted along the western reaches as Nevish Line flared into active contention, leaving one strategic position reduced to no-man's-land while both factions traded blows over Princefal and Blackcoat Way. Across the northern theatre, Weathered Expanse persists as a severe cauldron of attrition, absorbing over twelve thousand casualties in the past two hours alone amidst renewed assaults near Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Huntsfort. Extreme carnage likewise grips Stonecradle, where combined losses exceeded eighty-six hundred as Warden forces pressed against Colonial lines holding seven of nine local bastions. In Callahan’s Passage, persistent back-and-forth skirmishing continues around The Latch, where Colonial elements cling to a lone foothold against nine Warden strongholds. Contested fighting similarly endures across Stlican Shelf, where Breaker Town witnessed further tactical exchanges, while Linn of Mercy logged fresh skirmishes at Lathair. With frontline bases repeatedly trading hands from Nevish Line to Weathered Expanse, combat momentum remains fiercely divided.
